name: exercise-call
description: Exercise a filled call you hold before expiry: pay the total strike plus the 0.1% exercise fee in WETH and receive the tokens. Approve the CallMarket for strike * 1.001 WETH first, or exercise with ETH on kyte.sh/positions.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Option id (the OptionNFT token id). Read it from kyte.sh/market, the Kyte MCP (find_offers, get_positions) or the OfferCreated event.
